description: Station Siege: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: {station} is under siege and {client} has asked you to help hold it. Waves of {enemy} will come in over the next several minutes. Do not let the station fall.
Raiders are hitting {station}. The point-defence guns are not enough. Fly in and break the attacks.
The {station} has called for help. It is under attack and its guns are tired. Hold it.
success: The siege is lifted. {station} sends a message of thanks and {client} pays {captain}.
{station} survives. {client} pays and makes a note about better defences.
The attackers withdraw. {client} pays and the station's staff come out onto the observation deck to watch you go.
failure: The station falls. {client} bills you for the delay.
radio-first: First wave. Six fighters on the {station}.
Attackers inbound. They are going for the docking ring.
radio-second: Gunships heading for the station. Intercept.
Second wave. They have brought bombers.
They want the reactor. Stop them.
radio-third: Frigate coming into range. It will sit and shell the station.
Third wave, and it is the big one. Frigate with escorts.
Heavy contact. The frigate will outrange the point defences.
